Grammara Thirdconditional
Third conditional sentences describe hypothetical situations in the past.
Usethe past perfect inthe if clauseandwouldhave+past participlein themainclause
If I'd remembered,I would have brought her something.
if I hadn't forgotten, I would have brought her a gift.
If she had missed the party,she wouldn't have met Santiago
If shehadn'tgone to the party, she wouldn'thave met him.
Remember:I'd=Iwould orIhad
A Read the conditional sentences.Circle the true statements about them.
1 If Henry had made an effort, he would have passed all of his exams.
a. Henry made an effort.
a. Henry made an effort. b. Henry didn’t make an effort.
If Mike had followed the instructions, he wouldn't have made a mistake.
a. Mike made a mistake.
b. Mike didn’t make a mistake.
If Luz hadn't becomea doctor, she would havebecome an artist.
b. Luz didn't become a doctor.
a. Luz became a doctor.
If Andrea hadn't sold her old books online, she wouldn't have gotten rid of them.
a. Andrea got rid of her books.
a. Andrea got rid of her books. b. Andrea didn’t get rid of her books.
B Complete the sentences with the third conditional.
Then compare with a partner.
